scope: Selected book calibration chain and recent gravity/zeta modules; not exhaustive for 138 chapters

entries.name: address_shares
entries.note: Three numbers, two independent components.

entries.name: alpha_and_h
entries.note: Do not add these again to the target-coordinate count.

entries.name: energy_shares
entries.note: Distinct from address shares.

entries.name: H0
entries.note: Adopted Planck base-LCDM reference, not a newly derived exact constant.

entries.name: eta_sector
entries.note: Three coefficients; no extra independent inputs when calibration equations are enforced. If released separately they add freedom.

entries.name: L_H_C
entries.note: Discrete model choices remain in the ledger despite no continuous dimension.

entries.name: N_SOURCE
entries.note: Not an additional independent capacity parameter.

entries.name: admission_xi
entries.note: Frozen does not mean derived; fitting it later is a model revision.

entries.name: load_weight_slopes
entries.note: Two nonzero sector choices in this inherited family; not a new fit here.

entries.name: RAR_kappa
entries.note: Not a redefinition of geometric twist kappa.

entries.name: gate_hazard
entries.note: If released it changes a_eff through hazard^-2; cannot estimate separately from aT using local RAR alone.

entries.name: Plummer_M_and_b0
entries.note: Scenario inputs. If estimated from galaxy observations they are nuisance/source freedoms, not automatically zero.

entries.name: radius_impact_patch
entries.note: Changing the patch changes the conditional lens observable.

entries.name: gravitational_slip
entries.note: Free slip introduces an additional lens response freedom.

entries.name: tau
entries.note: Not part of the five reference-chain anchor components.

entries.name: edge_d
entries.note: Do not fit d and tau as independent scales while enforcing this relation.

entries.name: zero_heights
entries.note: 70 potential coordinates only IF independently retuned; currently no fitted height parameters.

entries.name: CRT_shape
entries.note: A different neighbor graph is a different candidate.

entries.name: combining_ray
entries.note: General CP^69 has 138 real dimensions IF the branch-blind contract is removed.

entries.name: carrier_density
entries.note: Arbitrary density matrix dimension 128^2-1 is not 16383 active fitted parameters. Pure-state family would have 254.

entries.name: eta_coherence
entries.note: One effective coordinate; do not count eta and s independently.

entries.name: efficiency
entries.note: Unknown efficiency and eta are two coordinates in the diagnostic extension; generated examples are synthetic.

entries.name: driven_control_law
entries.note: Zero fitted coordinates here does not make the physical clock/controller derived or cost-free.

entries.name: c_hbar_G
entries.note: Shared physical anchors must be treated symmetrically for comparison theories.

entries.name: CMB_As_ns_tau_reio
entries.note: Read from actual run_camb.py; not derived by the local reference-chain audit. Reionization optical depth differs from shutter time.

entries.name: CMB_mnu_Neff
entries.note: Not hidden or counted as new observational fits here.

entries.name: CMB_temperature
entries.note: Supplied to the inherited CAMB run; included for symmetric comparison accounting.
